activity: Initial quiet readiness; retain entry/before/after/terminal host observations. As in the accepted Cargo-parent protocol, background activity never selects or rejects instruction samples based on effect. No native elapsed claim.
baseline_label: SDK12 Cargo source fdd26156 rebuilt with the same stock producer; not the literal shipped SDK12 Cargo executable

budget.setup_profiles: One excluded native reference and one opaque parent profile per entered endpoint, arm and host; never samples.

child_environment: Keep the original live jobserver. Only differing CARGO_MAKEFLAGS descriptor values are omitted from comparison; raw ordered environment is retained. The validated loader removes its own instrumentation environment before native children.

decision_table.condition: A prerequisite, exact binary/context/output, trace, exit, completeness, integrity or restoration guard fails; any observation is missing
decision_table.decision: Cohort invalid/unqualified. Preserve every record; restore and park owned states. Keep incomplete/invalid effects unread. No replacement, extension, alternate host or retry of measured work.

decision_table.condition: Both complete raw/restoration gates pass, but either block has any tie/loss, sign p >= .01 or lower 99% reduction bound <= .01
decision_table.decision: A valid warm-check miss closes conditional endpoints. A valid test-build miss is reported independently; it does not erase qualified check results. No retries or pooled substitute.

decision_table.condition: Both complete raw/restoration and metric gates pass and each block has 8/8 wins, p < .01 and lower 99% reduction bound > .01
decision_table.decision: Both independent blocks must pass to qualify their own warm endpoint. No duplicate source PR. First-use cost is reported with either sign after complete gates.

endpoint_entry: Both warm-check blocks must independently qualify before test-build. First-use is a descriptive third endpoint only after both warm-check passes and a complete valid test-build decision; it uses independent copies of each same-host same-arm restored check bank. Any invalid cohort has no replacement or extension.

first_use_statistics.per_host_break_even: ceil(max(0, mean paired first-use candidate-minus-baseline Ir / mean paired warm-check baseline-minus-candidate Ir)); retain signed numerator and denominator.
first_use_statistics.uncertainty: Independent paired resampling within each phase, separately on each host; no pooling.

masking: Per endpoint, both complete16-record raw/restoration gates precede all32 metric joins, which precede either estimate. Excluded profiles are never samples. Check results are retained and reported independently before test-build entry.
metric: Final Callgrind Ir for the complete Cargo parent, all parent threads, trace-children=no; compiler/linker/build-script/test children excluded.
metric_integrity: Both complete raw/restoration gates before decoding; all 32 final/self/stderr and raw/gzip joins, exact command/Ir format, and no brk segment overflow warning before either statistical comparison.
native: Whole-command native wall time is a separate future protocol. Instrumented elapsed is diagnostic only.
preflight: Each endpoint/arm has its own source-only warmed bank. Warm and prove both original commands fresh before capturing that bank. One native dirty reference and one opaque Cargo-parent profile establish the exact selected endpoint compiler vectors, outputs, diagnostics and restoration. The native stdout/stderr references are explicit in the pinned preflight and joined to its completion manifest before collection and offline validation.

producer.physical_paths: one common source/target path for both builds
producer.toolchain: Stock Rust1.99; exact production build and functional receipts are bound by the Root matched-pair acceptance.

profiler_prerequisite.brk: Fail on any brk-overflow warning; no source, allocator or counter changes.
profiler_prerequisite.tools: Reuse the accepted R/Y expanded-brk 3.22 Callgrind and exact preload adapter; same tools on both machines, with fresh held-out controls and full file/alias verification before profiling.

publication: Combined evidence and next-hillclimb attribution only; no duplicative performance PR for already published changes.
purpose: Measure direct source-matched SDK12 to eight-change Cargo-parent counts on unchanged uv; preserve separate warm check, warm test-build and first-use cost.

registry_cache.baseline: fdd has no R1 cache; require absent before and after every sample.
registry_cache.candidate_first_use: Retire only the task-owned document directory by same-filesystem rename before the profile; retain all records. Require absent before and populated after.
registry_cache.candidate_warm: Full cache populated before and after, with exact X two-choice key[:3] or key[3:6] placement, file/ancestor trust, size and JSON guards.
registry_cache.format: R1 unchanged magic/format; new fdd embedded commit changes codec-key digest, which is observed freshly.

state_banks: Fresh independent source-only check banks per arm/host. Fresh independent test-build banks only after both primary passes. No compiled uv, target, shared, document cache or package-home state crosses arms/hosts. Fixed SDK/runtime leaves remain pinned; capture actual compiler namespaces rather than infer them.

statistics.estimator: geometric mean of paired candidate/baseline counts
statistics.multiple_testing: Both independent fixed VM blocks must pass separately; no pooled or additive claim.
statistics.sign: two-sided exact sign test, ties excluded in p and disqualifying for the 8/8 gate

workload_edit: Use the exact accepted donor fixture: append a deterministic ordinary non-doc comment, warm its state=before form, then change it to state=after_. The strings have equal length and five changed bytes. All Rust tokens and source positions remain unchanged. Restore the original source afterward; no production uv change.
workload_tools: Published SDK12 f93 Rust/rustdoc and fixed Wild execute uv, distinct from the stock producer compiler. Only Cargo varies.
